property_summary: For every call to sendTo(receiver, amount), the reference contract only allows the owner to execute the transfer (non-owner callers cannot make sendTo succeed); the mutant removing the owner check lets non-owners succeed for some inputs, violating this rule.
change_summary: Replace the owner check to allow anyone (remove require(msg.sender == owner)) so sendTo can be invoked by any caller, changing which transfers occur and thus observed behavior.
